summary: This +1 longsword gives drow wielders bonus Poison against Restrained targets and grants Ensnaring Strands.

fields.Sting the Helpless: Drow and creatures disguised as drow deal an extra 1d4 Poison to Restrained targets.
fields.Ensnaring Strands: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack for 1d10 + Strength modifier Slashing. The target makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or becomes Enwebbed for 10 turns. Enwebbed sets movement speed to zero, grants advantage to attackers and imposes disadvantage on the target’s attacks and Dexterity saves.
fields.Reported behavior: Looted from Kar’niss, the sword can retain Spindleweb Fanatic until Long Rest for an extra 1d6 Psychic on weapon attacks.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
